answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 158484 Country: India Title: Is it ok to do study after Asar salah? Question: Is it ok to do study after Asar salah? Answer ID: 158484 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 546/494/SD=6/1439) According to Shariah, there is no harm in studying after Asr salah, however we have come to know from some physicians that it is harmful for health to do mental work before sunset. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
